examples.ar: وَمَا الْحَيَاةُ الدُّنْيَا إِلَّا لَعِبٌ وَلَهْوٌ.
examples.en: And the worldly life is not but play and amusement.

examples.ar: تَحْمِلُ الحَيَاةُ بَيْنَ طَيَّاتِهَا فُرَصًا لَا تَنْتَهِي.
examples.en: Life carries within its folds endless opportunities.

examples.ar: يَسُودُ الحُبُّ الصَّادِقُ بَيْنَ النَّاسِ بِالاحْتِرَامِ المُتَبَادَلِ.
examples.en: True love prevails among people through mutual respect.
That is because God is the Truth.

examples.ar: مِنْ حَقِّ كُلِّ مُوَاطِنٍ التَّعْبِيرُ عَنْ رَأْيِهِ بِحُرِّيَّةٍ.
examples.en: It is the right of every citizen to express their opinion with freedom.

examples.ar: يُؤْتِي الْحِكْمَةَ مَنْ يَشَاءُ ۚ وَمَنْ يُؤْتَ الْحِكْمَةَ فَقَدْ أُوتِيَ خَيْرًا كَثِيرًا.
examples.en: He gives wisdom to whom He wills, and whoever has been given wisdom has certainly been given much good.
Freedom is a responsibility that requires respecting others.

examples.ar: الْتَّفَاهُمُ يَبْدَأُ بِحِوَارٍ هَادِئٍ وَبَنَّاءٍ بَيْنَ الأَطْرَافِ.
examples.en: Understanding begins with a calm and constructive dialogue between the parties.

translation: dream, aspiration, vision / also (حِلْم) forbearance, tolerance

examples.ar: تَحَقَّقَ حُلْمُ التَّخَرُّجِ بَعْدَ سَنَوَاتٍ مِنَ الجِدِّ.
examples.en: The graduation dream was achieved after years of diligence.

translation: civilization, culture, settled way of life

examples.ar: الحَضَارَةُ العَرَبِيَّةُ الأَنْدَلُسِيَّةُ كَانَتْ مَنَارَةً لِلعِلْمِ.
examples.en: The Arabic Andalusian civilization was a beacon of science.
